purpose.zh: 上背靠在椅子上，练臀部力量
purpose.en: Strengthen your glutes with your upper back on a chair.

text.zh: 脚跟踩地把髋往上推，顶端夹紧臀部
text.en: Push through your heels to lift your hips and squeeze your glutes at the top

text.zh: 上背靠在稳固椅子的边缘，双脚与髋同宽，手放在髋上。
text.en: Rest your upper back on the edge of a sturdy chair, feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips.

text.zh: 顶端大腿和身体成一条线，小腿竖直。
text.en: At the top, keep your thighs and body in one line with your shins upright.

commonErrors.en: Arching your lower back instead of using your glutes.

cautions.en: Make sure the chair is sturdy and will not slide.

cautions.zh: 腰疼时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back hurts, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 节奏按 spec：推起 1.0 / 停 1.3 / 放下 1.2 / 休 0.5 s
start 口令「顶髋」改口语「往上推」；cue2 补上动画里的手放髋上
